name: Infinite Library
body:
Price 8,000 gp; Aura moderate divination; CL 10; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This massive tome is a repository of all knowledge but no mortal is able to plumb its depths fully. The pages are infinite but seem to guide toward the information you seek when perusing the book. Once per day you can attempt a single Knowledge check (as if you were trained in the skill) with a +10 insight bonus to the check. To gain the bonus you must spend 2d6 hours reading the book. If you try to use the book further after the one use per day is used, the book never seems to turn to pages of information that are useful to you.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, pocket library
